correctness.rationale: Automaton acceptance separation is equivalent to A^a B^b != B^b A^a for some permutations. Power-generated H_t is normal; H_t=1 iff L_m|t. For m>=5 every nontrivial normal subgroup of S_m contains nonabelian A_m, so pairwise centralization fails; for m=3,4 the abelian A_3 and V_4 cases give the listed exceptional congruences. The function L_m increases precisely at prime powers, and explicit exponent witnesses prove the least-degree spectrum. For q>=7, failure at q−1 forces an exponent multiple of L_{q−1}, yielding sharp length and uniqueness. Exhaustive independent S3–S5 residue-pair checks corroborate, not replace normal-subgroup proof.
